name: Fiji
shortSummary: Fiji's large Indo-Fijian population (historically over a third of the country) anchors one of India's closest Pacific relationships, engaged through the FIPIC (Forum for India-Pacific Islands Cooperation) framework.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: A historic Indian-origin population, descended from 19th-century indentured labourers, underpins deep cultural ties.
Fiji has hosted and participated in India's Pacific Islands outreach summits.

sources.title: Bilateral brief
sources.publisher: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
